visualCharacteristics: rc3: White bar, 6 centered links with vertical separators, gradient underline on the active link, sticky under the header. New custom block (no library equivalent): in-page anchor bar, sticky under the header, scroll-spy underline.

contentPattern.authoring: One row, one cell: a bulleted list of links to in-page anchors (#our-approach ...). Each target section sets the same id in section metadata (key id). Put the block in its own section: that section becomes sticky under the header.

usage.description: Sticky in-page anchor bar under the hero; marks the link for the section in view.

reuseGuidance: Use on long pages that need an on-page table of contents. Not for site navigation.
